Name: Deer and llama sounds
Author: Greenoctahedron
Description:
This mod works if you're using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3167]Elle's New Barn Animals mod[/url] and you want your deers and llamas to sound like actual deers and llamas. :) 

In my case, I have replaced the cows for deers and the sheep for llamas. 

The mod requires having the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3043?tab=posts&BH=5 ]Custom Music mod[/url] installed and working.
[list]
[*]The llama sound is from this video, which I found to be extremely cute: [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mWs7XG27LOA]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mWs7XG27LOA[/url]
[*]The deer sound is from SoundCloud: [url=https://soundcloud.com/ivo-vicic/red-deer-and-roe-deer-roaring-barking-and-other-sounds-professional-sound-library-preview]https://soundcloud.com/ivo-vicic/red-deer-and-roe-deer-roaring-barking-and-other-sounds-professional-sound-library-preview[/url]
[/list]I hope you like it!
